copy.intro: The long version of a big GMC SUV, with space behind the back seats for hockey bags and a week of luggage. Made for family trips out of town.
good_for: Road trips with lots of luggage

faq.question: What fuel does the Yukon XL take?
faq.answer: It runs on gas, so you can fill it at any regular station along the way.

faq.question: Can I use my phone's maps and music on the screen?
faq.answer: Yes. It has Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, and Bluetooth for calls and audio.

faq.question: Can I warm it up before I get in on a cold morning?
faq.answer: Yes, the Yukon XL has remote start, so you can get the engine and heat going from inside the house.

copy.intro: Five seats, heated front seats and four-wheel drive for slushy side streets. A compact SUV that fits a family weekend and still parks easily.

faq.question: How many people fit in the Tucson?
faq.answer: It seats 5, and the cargo area behind the back seats takes their bags.

faq.question: Is the Tucson a good choice for snow?
faq.answer: It has four-wheel drive, and lane keeping assist and forward collision alert give you an extra set of eyes in slow winter traffic.

faq.question: What fuel does it use?
faq.answer: The Tucson runs on gas and has an automatic transmission.

faq.question: Can I connect my phone?
faq.answer: Yes. Pair it over Bluetooth, or plug in for Apple CarPlay and Android Auto on the screen.
